title: No Autostart
author: rosssnowden
summary: PowerToys intermittently fails to be present after startup or a prolonged sleep period even though Run at startup is enabled.
next_action: Consolidate evidence into issue 23193 rather than splitting the same startup failure across trackers.

confidence.rationale: The same symptom is explicitly cross-linked to the open canonical tracker.

judgment.rationale: The thread explicitly links the same symptom to the older open startup tracker 23193, and multiple commenters describe the same intermittent whole-app startup failure.
evidence: Multiple users confirm Run at startup is enabled but PowerToys must be launched manually.
The reporter says the problem commonly follows a prolonged sleep period.
A commenter explicitly links issue 23193, which remains open with the same startup symptom.
Two diagnostic ZIPs are already attached in this thread.
judgment.recommended_action: Consolidate evidence into issue 23193 rather than splitting the same startup failure across trackers.

fix_assessment.rationale: This issue duplicates the existing open startup tracker; a separate competing fix assessment would fragment the same investigation.

issue_context.summary: PowerToys intermittently fails to be present after startup or a prolonged sleep period even though Run at startup is enabled.
known_information: Reports cover Store installs, versions 0.98.1 and 0.99.1, and both normal and administrator mode.
The failure is intermittent rather than a permanently disabled startup setting.
Fresh diagnostics were attached by two affected users.
inferences: Sleep/resume may be relevant for at least one path, but the evidence does not prove one common root cause for every reporter.
issue_context.analysis: The oldest tracker is the appropriate place to compare startup registration, resume, and process-exit evidence.
initial_investigation: Checked live issue 23193 and confirmed it remains open.
Compared this issue with 48567, which reports the same whole-app symptom.

actions.label: Consolidate with startup tracker 23193

comment.body: This report matches the still-open general startup tracker #23193: PowerToys is configured to run at startup but is intermittently absent and must be launched manually. This thread adds useful sleep/resume timing and diagnostic archives. Please consolidate that evidence into #23193 so startup registration and process-exit investigation remains in one place.

actions.note: Draft only; no upstream comment is posted without explicit approval.
